items.title: Natty Dominique Interview, 1967-11-15
items.q: Paul, he said, yeah, that'll do it.

ctx.x: So, he died. They buried his planet with him. His planet, his planet, his planet,

his planet, his planet, his planet. And they had another one, Lorenzo Teo. An old man, Teo. I'm gonna tell you, your dad, if you at least tell you. You know where you used to go out? On the wagon. And he started playing that jazz music. He'd run in there. He'd run in there. I'd say, please let me get under your bed. You know, he jazz. What a musician. You could sit right here. And he started playing that claddle. He'd take me two blocks away. Old man watching that. His son, his son, Lorenzo was the planet. Well,…
